title: Rabbi Assi bar Chanina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 56a: Rav Acha bar Avya sat before Rabbi Assi and said in the name of Rabbi Assi bar Chanina, “Sea squill forms a boundary in a convert’s property.” Hyman proposes the reading Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina, and so it is in Dikdukei Soferim. What Seder HaDorot cites, that he is mentioned in Bava Batra 129a and 133a, is absent from Hyman’s Gemara texts; and in Bekhorot 34b Hyman reports it already corrected there to Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina.

notes.text: חצובא is sea squill used as a field boundary, not a caper bush. Saved Davidson English Bava Batra 56a explicitly identifies sea squill and its boundary function. Hyman’s emendation to Yose, negative observations and correction report remain attributed.
